title: Why-dropped split is hidden entirely for a class whose only drops are 2.3 severed culls — the residual the code promises ('every loss keeps a named cause') is never named
detail: A class whose losses are ALL severance culls (demolish a node with stuck packets; the class never shed E9/E22) has no drop_reasons row, so the guard fails and the gauge shows 'drop N' with no cause — the split neither names the residual nor sums, in exactly the demolition scenario gap 4 exists for.
recommended_fix: Drop the row-existence gate: when acc.dropped > 0, read app.drop_reasons[c] via a bounds-checked access defaulting to zero (or pre-grow rows to len(cat.packet_types) in start_run) so 'severed N' always renders.

title: The claimed programmatic pixel-scan of the new app-layer surfaces has no artifact in the diff — the PR body's verification is self-reported and unverifiable from the repo
location: pr_body.md (Verification) + _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-v2-visibility.md (Verification) — no scratch script/output/image exists anywhere in the worktree
evidence: pr_body.md: "Scratch pixel-scan (rlsw shadow + LoadImageFromScreen): pool bar fill, SHEDDING tag, and drop-marker positions verified programmatically; QoS depth row layout measured against the rendered label" — vs spec-v2-visibility.md: "**Manual checks (if no CLI):** Scratch capture (rlsw shadow + LoadImageFromScreen, the 5.3 addendum recipe): drive `draw_world` + `draw_pool_gauge` + `draw_drop_markers` on a surge fixture; PIL-scan the pool-bar rect for the expected fill color + a marker's presence near a known bundle midpoint; confirm no overlap with the SLA block rect." — `find . -name '*scratch*' -o -name '*pixel*' -o -name '*scan*'` returns nothing; LoadImageFromScreen appears only in harness/
detail: The harness (green, 29/29 — independently re-run) proves T2-invisibility by construction but cannot verify the new surfaces' actual rendering, which is app-layer by design; the scan claim rests solely on the PR body's assertion.
recommended_fix: Commit the scratch capture/scan script + its output (or a note of where the evidence lives) so the gauge-fill / SHEDDING-tag / marker-anchor verification is reproducible, not self-reported.
